novel.justification: This is a proposal-specific edgewise sensitivity restriction, distinct from Fenaroli's cohort-level bounds on anticipation-related increments. The application protocol records the public decision date \(\mathsf a(h)\) and implementation date \(h\) for every canonical cohort path, declares \(t<\mathsf a(h)\) clean, and preregisters a separate interval \([\ell_e,u_e]\) for each announcement-to-implementation cell \(\mathsf a(h)\le t<h\). Each interval is calibrated on the outcome scale from subject-matter limits on the largest plausible response to that announced path, supplemented where available by placebo shifts from comparable preannouncement cohorts; asymmetric responses are represented by asymmetric endpoints.
